$comment: Golden-image set for the graphics regression gate. See docs/GRAPHICS_BENCHMARK_HARNESS.md.
Presets are chosen to cover the render paths the FPS recovery work (#174) touches, not to
look impressive: the empty/solid presets pin the clear + final-blit path, the per-pixel ones
pin the warp mesh, the compshader ones pin the composite path (and the extra Y-flip that
presets *without* a composite shader pay), the noise ones pin RNG determinism end to end,
and the heavy custom preset covers a real multi-pass warp+blur frame.
Capture frames are absolute render-frame indices, counted from the first pumped frame.
settleFrames must stay >= the longest shader compile in the set — the capture asserts
readiness after a fixed settle rather than waiting, so that the frame schedule is fixed.
Applied when comparing against committed goldens on a DIFFERENT machine or driver.
The same-runner, same-commit repeat check is byte-exact and ignores these.
minSsim catches structural change (a flip, a dropped pass, a dead preset);
maxDifferingFraction catches localized damage a whole-image average would dilute.
